name: one real command sets everything up
looks: A headline claims the whole setup is one command, no key required. A dark terminal panel types out that exact command, a status line confirms the connection a beat later with a check mark, and a second command begins typing right after, unprompted.
build: DOM mono text revealed per character with kit.typeOn; the status line reveals after a short pause, a coloured dot plus a word, fading and sliding up 4-6px, same mechanic as terminal-type-on; the second command starts typing immediately after, no cut.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character and a single confirm tone on the status line.
prompt: Claim the whole setup takes one command and no key, then type that exact command into a dark terminal panel, let a status line confirm the connection with a check mark, and have a second command begin typing right after, unprompted, to show the tool is immediately ready to work.
